title: Framing + ops onboarding for CobaltAI pilot — scope, metrics, access
text:
Framing + ops onboarding for CobaltAI pilot — scope, metrics, access

["From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@cobaltai.com>, Priya Singh <priya@cobaltai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Framing + ops onboarding for CobaltAI pilot — scope, metrics, access

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the ops items we discussed so we have a single source of truth to move to kickoff. If anything below looks off, call it out and we’ll adjust.

1) Key pain & goals (from your side)
- High per-query cost when running embedding + rerank at scale (topline ask: reduce unit cost 2–3x).
- Latency spikes during peak traffic causing poor UX (goal: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms).
- Sensitive PII and regulatory constraints for EU customers — must redaction & audit trail.

2) Proposed pilot scope (initially): 4-week ingestion + eval sprint targeting one vertical (support search). Deliverables:
- Instrumented inference pipeline on Redwood (hosted/dedicated staging).
- Prompt/eval set (approx 250 labelled prompts across 5 buckets).
- Cost & latency baseline, and optimized config (batching + KV caching) with suggested quantization.
- Acceptance gates: embedding semantic accuracy >= 92% on eval set; cost improvement target 2x; p50 latency < 150ms.

3) Metrics we will track (dashboard):
- p50 / p95 generation latency (end-to-end).
- Cost per 1k tokens + per-embedding unit.
- Eval pass rate (semantic-match tolerances).
- Error rate and audit log completeness.

4) Owners and roles
- Customer: Liam O'Connor — pilot owner, will validate eval buckets and provide baseline logs.
- Customer: Priya Singh — security point of contact for questionnaire and SOC2 evidence.
- Redwood: Hannah Schmitt — engagement lead (schedules, acceptance criteria, rollout).
- Redwood: Karthik Iyer — SE lead (env setup, observability instruments).

5) Timeline (proposed)
- Aug 5–12: access + environment prep, initial dataset drop and baseline logs.
- Aug 13–20: ingest + first-run eval, iterate prompt set.
- Aug 21–26: optimization window (batching, cache, quantization).
- Aug 27: acceptance demo & decision on expanded pilot / Dedicated trial.

6) Access & ops checklist (what we need from CobaltAI)
- Create a service account: cobalt-pilot@cobaltai-svc (or provide equivalent IAM) with S3 read to s3://cobaltai-pilot-uploads.
- Temporary S3 credentials (or a signed URL) for sample dataset (scoped, 7-day).
- IP allowlist: please open 3.4.5.6 and 3.4.5.7 to our staging endpoints (we asked for short-lived access).
- Security questionnaire items: point Priya to security-redwood@redwoodinference.com.

Attachments: pilot-charter-draft.pdf (high-level charter), prompt-eval-template.csv (schema for labeled prompts).

Next steps / asks from you by EOD Aug 12: confirm pilot owner, send baseline logs (anonymized) or a sample, and confirm whether we can proceed with the Aug 13 ingest window.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into motion.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the thorough write-up — this matches our read. Two quick asks/notes from our side:

1) Timeline: we need a 6-week window rather than 4 (internal stakeholders want an extra iteration after optimization). Can you revise the schedule to a 6-week cadence?

2) Security: attaching our SOC2 summary and we also have a short internal questionnaire (I’ve started filling it out, Priya will finish). Can your security team expect a detailed list by next Tue?

3) Baseline logs: we can deliver an anonymized sample (approx 10k interactions) by Aug 12 — sending as signed S3 link.

I’m copying Priya to confirm she’s comfortable with the IP allowlist and the service account naming. Otherwise, proceed and we’ll align on the revised timeline.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Product, CobaltAI

Attachments: cobalt-soc2-summary.pdf
